help.short: ETag of the Windows IoT Device Service. Do not specify for creating a new Windows IoT Device Service. Required to update an existing Windows IoT Device Service.

description: Create the metadata of a Windows IoT Device Service. The usual pattern to modify a property is to retrieve the Windows IoT Device Service metadata and security metadata, and then combine them with the modified values in a new body to update the Windows IoT Device Service.
